description: Look up a super PAC or hybrid PAC in the Super PAC Donors Register by committee name substring, as the FEC committee master lists it, or by its committee id (C followed by 8 digits). Returns up to 5 committees, each for the 2025-26 and 2023-24 cycles with its name, id and committee type as the FEC lists them, and three measures, each labelled and never combined into one figure: organisation contributions by reviewed class (issue and social-welfare groups split by IRS match; withheld and unreviewed money as amounts only), contributions from committees, and itemized contributions from individuals, counted only; conduit pass-through rows (ActBlue, WinRed) are shown apart under their own label and are excluded from every total. Each cycle lists the largest named organisation donors to that committee and the committee's own FEC summary line. Super PACs and hybrid PACs are named exactly as the FEC committee master lists them, with their committee ids and no party or candidate label; a contribution to a super PAC is not a contribution to a candidate. Organisation, committee and individual money into super PACs are three measures, each labelled and never combined into one figure. Organisation money is not corporate money: every total states its class. The word nonprofit appears only on a record an exact IRS Exempt Organizations match carries, shown with that record; other issue and social-welfare groups read organisation (status not matched). Every answer carries the register's question note: these records show contributions reported to the FEC; they do not show what any donor received or intended, and they do not show cause and effect. Individual donors are counted, never named; withheld strings (trusts, holding vehicles, businesses named for a person, names resting on initials, unmatched committees) and unreviewed strings appear only as counts and amounts. Every answer quotes the FEC's restriction on the sale or use of individual contributor information (52 U.S.C. 30111(a)(4)) and the FEC bulk file date; the bulk file lags the committees' latest reports.

committee.description: Required case-insensitive committee name substring as the FEC lists it, or a committee id (C and 8 digits); at most 80 characters.
